# H1.0 — The Survey

**Machine state: `config/survey.json`. Sampling runs every 8h until 2026-09-07T00:00:00Z (enforced in `tools/sample.py`, which reads this file). Decision at 2026-08-24T12:00:00Z.**

## The question

Which venue offers the cheapest-to-measure base rates per unit of effort? No a-priori answer exists, so it is bought with a one-week survey scored on weights fixed before the data.

## Candidates

`solana`, `base`, `eth`, `bsc`

## Scoring criteria — weights fixed before the data

| criterion | weight |
|---|---|
| event volume | 30% |
| base rate measurability | 30% |
| resolution speed | 20% |
| data reliability | 20% |

Weights sum to 1.00 (CI check I13 fails otherwise).

## Outcome definitions — computable, no discretion at grade time

| class | test |
|---|---|
| death_class | `reserve_in_usd < 0.05 x observed peak within 72h of first observation, or pool 404s on individual re-query` |
| survivor_class | `at day 14: reserve_in_usd >= 0.50 x observed peak AND >= venue median launch reserve_in_usd across all committed cohorts` |
| unmeasurable | `fetch error; never folded into either outcome` |

## Census thresholds — what the decision wake must do

- cohorts < **14** → journal a sampling_gap incident
- cohorts < **8** → STOP, journal insufficient-data, append a `survey_extended` event (without it the sampler refuses to run past the end date)

## Excluded by construction

- execution-latency strategies
- any venue requiring paid data before H1 passes

## Known limits, stated now

- 3 pages x 20 pools per snapshot is a thin sample of a firehose; adequate for base rates and ranking, not for coverage. lint-exempt
- 8 divides 24, so every sample lands at the same three clock times: this cancels for cross-network ranking but biases absolute base rates; H1 cadence must correct it. lint-exempt
- GeckoTerminal free tier is an unverified dependency; 429s were observed 2026-08-18 and the sampler now paces at 2.5s. lint-exempt
- Peak is the max observed across snapshots, so it is an underestimate: the death test under-counts deaths rather than inflating them. lint-exempt
